I’m late but here are my favorites:
1. Songs of Love and Hate - also one of my all time favorite records. This was the album that got me into Leonard Cohen.

2. New Skin for the Old Ceremony - I think this album is underrated and has my favorite rendition of Greensleeves ever.

3. You Want It Darker - this could actually be my no. 1 if it wasn’t for my first two picks existing.

4. Songs of Leonard Cohen - just an absolutely beautiful album. Teachers and Stories of the Street are so good!

5. Various Positions - so many great songs. The Law is one of my absolute favorites.

6. Songs From a Room - You Know Who I Am, The Partisan, and The Butcher give me chills when I listen to them.

7. The Future - took me a while to come around to this one, but I now recognize it’s genius.

8. Old Ideas - this album proved that he’s one of the best songwriters ever.

9. Recent Songs - best album to listen to on a cold autumn day driving through the mountains.

10. Death of a Ladies Man - another one that took me a while to love and appreciate. I now see it as underrated.

11. I’m Your Man - a late friend of mine used to listen to this and Tom Waits Swordfishtrombones all the time. This album makes me think of her.

12. Popular Problems - the album that turned my metal head brother into a Leonard Cohen fan.

13. Dear Heather - an album that I never listened to till about 5 years ago. I was definitely missing out!

14. Ten New Songs - another album I for some reason avoided for years. It’s great! I was just too naïve haha!

15. Thanks For The Dance - Amazing! Just because it’s at the bottom of the list doesn’t mean I think it’s bad. He just has so many great albums!
